name: Danon病

summary.text: A rare X-linked genetic condition due to deficiency of the lysosomal-associated membrane protein 2 (LAMP2) characterized by severe cardiomyopathy and variable degrees of muscle weakness, frequently associated with intellectual deficits (in males).
